meta.name: anti-slop
meta.description: Eliminate AI-sounding patterns from any written output. Applies editorial rules synthesized from the best open-source anti-slop tools: banned phrases, structural pattern detection, false agency checks, and a scoring rubric. Use as a quality gate for ANY content — blog posts, social media, emails, documentation, marketing copy. Triggers on: "make it sound human", "less AI", "remove slop", "humanize this", "doesn't sound natural", "too AI", "rewrite naturally", or when reviewing any AI-generated text before publishing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 消除AI腔调，让文字读起来自然
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想避免文章读起来像AI生成的
copy.tagline_en: Remove AI-sounding patterns to make text read naturally
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to avoid text that sounds AI-generated

howto.what: 装好后,它检查你的文字:找禁用短语、假拟人、破折号、空泛词,按五项打分,低于35分强制重写,再自检一轮,让文字更像人写的。
howto.when: 当你说“让它像人写的”“少点AI味”“改自然点”等,或让它审核任何AI生成内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看这篇博客有没有AI腔,改一下。
把这段话改得自然点,别太像AI。
给这段营销文案做反AI味检查并打分。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude scans text for banned phrases, false agency, em-dash overuse, and vague wording, then scores it /50 across five criteria. If under 35, it rewrites and self-critiques the draft to sound more human.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to make text sound human, less AI, or more natural, or when reviewing any AI-generated text before publishing.

say_en.text: Could you check this blog post for AI-sounding phrases and revise it?
Make this paragraph sound more natural, less like AI.
Run an anti-slop check and score this marketing copy.
